_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: auto-claims
summary: Motor vehicle claims: policy, coverage, claim, incident, handling, money in and out.

changelog.note: Declares its shapes: a claim claims under exactly one policy and arises from exactly one incident, a payment is charged to and paid to exactly one, an item is part of one claim, a decision decides one claim; claim numbers, states, policy numbers and incident dates are required.
Ships its competency questions (questions.json): every class, relation and attribute is cited by a question that runs, and the sample answers each one it must.

Declares its namespace: its terms keep one IRI in the RDF export of every project that uses it. The states of a claim and of a task are schemes: each value has a label, a definition, and reopened and in_progress are kinds of open.
Manifest added; the temporal vocabulary is now inherited from oto-core.
performs: a Role carries out a Procedure (inverse performed_by). The relation every procedure document needs and the graph could not hold.
